input.summary: paginate() used page * per_page as the start offset, which is right for 0-based pages. I changed it to (page - 1) * per_page. I added regression tests, and the full suite passes after the change.

claims.statement: Root cause: the start offset was page * per_page, which is wrong for 1-based pages.
The new tests failed before the fix: page 1 returned items starting at 10, and page 2 returned only [20..24].
After changing the offset to (page - 1) * per_page, all 5 tests pass. These cover page 1, middle and last pages, a page past the end returning [], and page 0 raising ValueError.

input.uncertainty: Only the unit tests were run. I did not check the callers that render the orders list, and the repository has no such callers that I saw.
